first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: teal stadium seating
entities.identification: Teal seats arranged in large sections in the stands, with gray stairs and passageways between sections.

entities.name: stadium roof and trusses
entities.identification: The light-gray long-span canopy covering the stands and its repeated trusses.

entities.name: pink-purple illuminated racing gate set
entities.identification: In this clip, this specifically corresponds to the pink-purple illuminated rectangular entrance frame to the image-left of Object M, leading to the interior passageway.

entities.name: green stadium turf
entities.identification: The broad green ground inside the stadium, with alternating broad light and dark stripes visible on its surface.

entities.name: gray sideline passageway
entities.identification: The long, narrow gray road surface between the turf and the low sideline wall, with a yellow longitudinal line visible in the near section.

entities.name: Object L
entities.identification: The white pentagonal thick-framed gate on the turf on the right, hollow inside, with a pink bottom and a partially pink-purple illuminated inner edge.

entities.name: Object M
entities.identification: The tall, narrow framed gate to the right of the entrance, with slender uprights bearing repeated cyan-blue illuminated segments and a wider white cap panel and pink-purple frame edge at the top.

entities.name: stadium floodlight strip
entities.identification: The bright white light points and rows of lights near the stadium roof.

entities.name: passageway floor
entities.identification: The gray hard-surfaced floor of the interior passageway, illuminated by purple-orange light, with a yellow line visible in places.

entities.name: passageway wall
entities.identification: The solid walls on both sides of the interior passageway, with a dark strip along the junction with the floor; a wall corner occludes the passageway farther away.

entities.name: purple-orange passageway light fixture
entities.identification: The purple linear light source and localized orange-yellow light source along the edge of the interior passageway.

entities.name: upper-level black display screen
entities.identification: The dark rectangular display screen near the upper-level stands, with a bright light-colored pattern on the screen.

entities.name: teal low sideline wall
entities.identification: The continuous opaque teal wall strip extending along the sideline passageway and the lower edge of the seating.

At frame 0, the green stadium turf appears as a broad, approximately flat green surface, with alternating broad light and dark stripes visible; the turf extends from the lower part of the image toward Object L and the sideline in front of the seating behind it, and its left edge converges toward slightly left of the center of the image; the visible area does not show continuous left and right bends defined by boundaries.

At frame 0, the gray sideline passageway is a long, narrow gray hard-surfaced roadway; its near section runs straight along the edge of the green stadium turf, while its far end connects near Object M to a wider road surface and to the entrance of the pink-purple illuminated racing gate set on the image-left; a short section of floor is visible inside the entrance, while the area farther away is occluded by the wall beside the gate.

At frame 58, the passageway walls are relatively light-colored solid surfaces that appear gray-purple and warm-colored under the purple-orange lighting, with a dark strip along the junction with the floor.
